messages.subject: MSstatsPTM localization probability in DIANN converter
messages.subject_clean: MSstatsPTM localization probability in DIANN converter
messages.body_plain:
Dear MSstats team,

Thank you for developing and maintaining this software. I'm currently analyzing phosphoproteomics data with MSstatsPTM. As I am using DIA-NN, I noticed that the DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat does not include a PTM Site Confidence cutoff, while for other converters, such as FragPipe, you have included it.  Is this something that is still in development, or is there a specific reason it was omitted for DIA-NN? In the meantime, would you recommend filtering the DIA-NN report by site confidence before passing it to the converter?

Thanks in advance for your help!

Ioanna

messages.subject: Re: MSstatsPTM localization probability in DIANN converter
messages.subject_clean: MSstatsPTM localization probability in DIANN converter
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ioanna,

No specific reason it was omitted. Our DIA-NN PTM converter predates the site localization handling we added for FragPipe, and it was not carried across. It is a sensible filter to have, so we will look at adding it.

I checked our DIA-NN examples and PTM.Site.Confidence is there in the 2.0 parquet reports. Could you let me know which DIA-NN version you are on, whether you export parquet or TSV, and whether PTM.site.Confidence is the column you have in mind? We want the filter to work across the versions people actually use.

In the meantime, yes, filtering the report by site confidence before passing it to the converter is reasonable and gives the same result. FragPipe uses 0.75 as its default cutoff if you want a starting point.

Best,
Swaraj
